def placement_margin(s):
    from robocasa.utils import object_utils as OU
    obj=s.env.objects['obj']; body=s.data.body(obj.root_body)
    pts=np.asarray(obj.get_bbox_points(trans=body.xpos,rot=np.roll(body.xquat,-1)))
    u,v,w=pts[1]-pts[0],pts[2]-pts[0],pts[3]-pts[0]
    centers=[pts[0]+.5*u+.5*v,pts[0]+.5*u+.5*v+w,
             pts[0]+.5*u+.5*w,pts[0]+.5*u+.5*w+v,
             pts[0]+.5*v+.5*w,pts[0]+.5*v+.5*w+u,pts.mean(axis=0)]
    pts=np.vstack([pts,centers])*.8+pts.mean(axis=0)*.2
    spawn=OU.get_highest_spawn_region(s.env,s.env.objects['container'])
    g=s.model.geom(spawn.get('name')).id
    local=(pts-s.data.geom_xpos[g])@s.data.geom_xmat[g].reshape(3,3)
    margins=s.model.geom_size[g]-abs(local)
    mins=margins.min(axis=1)
    result={'keypoints_inside':int((mins>=0).sum()),'second_best_margin_m':float(np.sort(mins)[-2]),
            'pepper_center_in_tier_frame':((body.xpos-s.data.geom_xpos[g])@s.data.geom_xmat[g].reshape(3,3)).tolist()}
    print(result,flush=True)
    return result
